foreignObject.div: Figure 13. The label's value cannot be measured by differencing two runs, and can be measured inside one — pre-registered, and demonstrated at scale. A five-class label carries at most H(class) = 2.32 bits, under this corpus's ~2.5-bit run-to-run floor. The paired gap — unconditional minus conditional bits/drawing, matched runs at two seeds — reads +6.39 and +2.24: 4.14 bits apart, one of them past the ceiling, which no property of a label can explain. The free classifier — p(c | x) ∝ p(x | c)·p(c), five forward passes of one checkpoint, no cross-model term — reads I(X; C) = +2.25 and +2.28, 0.029 apart, at 97% of the ceiling: a drawing carries nearly all of its own class. Its accuracy (0.991, 0.993) respects the Fano bound its own H(C | X) predicts (0.993, 0.996), and asked to draw each class in turn, the model reads back the class it was asked for in 512 of 512 samples against a chance of 0.2.
